navbar.notes: navy-900 top bar, 64px tall, 2px brand-red bottom border; app icon (warehouse mark) + 'StockFlow' title on the left, nav links on the right; active link uses brand-red. Persistent across pages.

page.notes: warm-oat (--color-page) background, centered ~960px content column; page__header holds page__title with the warehouse app icon next to the name. Single column on detail/form pages, grid on index pages.

card.notes: white surface on warm-oat, navy-tinted --shadow-sm, gentle --radius-md; the stock table and detail panels live in cards; --space-5 padding.

button.variants: btn--primary (solid brand-red, sharp 0px corners, hover brand-red-hover, primary actions Receive/Pick/Save only), btn--secondary (outlined), btn--ghost (text-only); tap targets min 44x44px on tablet
button.notes: primary carries the only brand-red on the page; keep the rest calm.

form_input.notes: persistent visible label (not placeholder-only), --radius-sm, clear focus ring using --color-info; validation problem shown inline next to the field naming the field; tap target >=44x44px.

table.notes: cool uppercase header row; quantity cells right-aligned using --font-mono with tabular-nums so columns align; high-contrast, calm, scannable stock-by-location grid.

status_badge.variants: badge--in-stock, badge--low (warning), badge--out (error), badge--on-order (info), badge--quarantined (navy); pill shape --radius-pill, --text-xs uppercase
status_badge.notes: state carried by BOTH text and color/shape, never color alone (e.g. reads 'out' AND uses error color, 'low' AND warning color).

empty_state.notes: line-style icon + teaching heading + guiding copy + a CTA in the StockFlow voice (e.g. 'No stock at this location, receive an inbound shipment'); a SKU with no batch/serial reads 'not tracked'; never a blank region.

toast.notes: fixed top-right; feedback never shifts page layout; a failed barcode scan flashes the scan zone red and shows a persistent toast, a success flashes green and updates the stock row in place.

scan_zone.notes: primary warehouse-floor input; success flashes green with the stock row updating in place, failure (unknown barcode, locked SKU) flashes red plus a persistent error toast.
